summary: Frontend-only testing of CR-047 mock design at https://central-inventory-11.preview.emergentagent.com/CR-047_MOCK_DESIGN_REAL_DATA.html. Tested all 6 specified features related to payment section layout and dynamic ref sub-row behavior.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 CR-047 features verified on mock HTML page. Vendor/Date/Fare/Payment header in single row, dynamic ref sub-row appears only for UPI/Bank Transfer, Cash+UPI split shows correct per-leg behavior, Cash+Cash split shows side-by-side layout without ref rows.

test_results.header_row_no_wrap: PASS - Vendor, Purchase Date, Fare, Payment all visible in single header row
test_results.cash_no_ref_row: PASS - Cash mode shows no ref sub-row (#payRef0 not visible)
test_results.bank_transfer_ref_row: PASS - Bank Transfer mode shows ref sub-row (#payRef0 visible)
test_results.upi_ref_row: PASS - UPI mode shows ref sub-row (#payRef0 visible with placeholder 'Ref / Transaction ID (optional)')
test_results.cash_plus_upi_split: PASS - Cash leg: no ref row; UPI leg: ref sub-row present
test_results.cash_plus_cash_split: PASS - Both Cash legs side-by-side on same row, no ref rows shown
